newsitem.title: FINLAND: GOVT MAY FORCE NESTE, IVO MERGER - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: GOVT MAY FORCE NESTE, IVO MERGER - PAPER.

text.p: The Finnish government may force a merger of its energy groups Neste and unlisted Imatran Voima (IVO) if studies to be completed this month prove it rational, business daily Kauppalehti reported on Monday.
"The owner has the final word. If rational, IVO and Neste can be forced together," it quoted Minister of Trade and Industry Antti Kalliomaki as saying.
"Studies have progressed well and they should be completed this month. After that, decisions will be made quickly since we cannot tread water for long with these firms," he said. @
Kalliomaki said the companies would be heard but that the project was up to the owners. The state owns 96 percent of IVO and 84 percent of Neste.

Kauppalehti reported last Tuesday that Imatran Voima's adviser Salomon Brothers saw few synergies in a merger and daily Helsingin Sanomat on Sunday said that a total of five advisers were involved in studying the possible merger.
